nodes.label: WebUI Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Centralized CSS custom properties (RGB channel variables) in globals.css `:root` with 25 reusable component classes. Eliminated ~400+ hardcoded rgba() values across 30 component files. Theme by changing RGB values in ONE file — everything cascades. Variables use per-channel format (--brand-r/g/b) for arbitrary alpha opacity.

nodes.label: System Prompt Optimization
nodes.rationale: Rewrote all prompts using Markdown + XML hybrid format. Markdown for readable structure (headings, lists, tables), XML tags for critical constraints. Removed narrative fluff, combined behaviors into single directives. Total reduction: ~4,872 → ~4,125 tokens (15%).
